title: The Picnic Surprise Buns
markdown:
Once upon a time, in a cozy cottage, lived Poppy the goose and Daisy the pony. Poppy loved to flap and honk with joy. Daisy loved to trot, her tail swishing happily. Their Aunt Olive had a smile as warm as sunshine.

Every day, Poppy and Daisy chased butterflies and nibbled sweet clover. But the best part was Aunt Olive’s yummy treats!

One sunny morning, Aunt Olive planned a picnic in a meadow full of wildflowers. A friendly robin baker hopped over. "I've brought buns for your picnic!" chirped the robin. "Here are plain, berry, and surprise buns."

The robin baker placed the warm buns on a tray. But *whoosh!* A cheeky gust of wind blew the little paper labels right off the buns! They danced high into the tickly grass, gone like magic. Oh dear!

Poppy, Daisy, and Aunt Olive looked at the buns. The labels were gone. "This one looks soft," honked Poppy. "It must be berry!" Daisy nudged a firmer bun. "Maybe this one is plain?" Aunt Olive chuckled. "Or perhaps," she whispered, "it’s the surprise!"

They decided to share and taste each bun together. Poppy took a bite. "Mmm, it’s soft and tastes… plain!" she honked, a little surprised but happy. Daisy nibbled her bun. "Mine is sweet and sticky with yummy berries!" she said. Aunt Olive tried the last one. She smiled. "This one is wonderfully sweet and bursting with berry flavour too!"

Poppy and Daisy giggled, and Aunt Olive laughed with them.

They learned a cheerful lesson. Sharing was the best part of any picnic, even if you guessed the buns wrong! Poppy tried Daisy's berry bun. Daisy enjoyed Aunt Olive's berry bun. Aunt Olive tasted Poppy's plain bun. And guess what? Every single bun tasted wonderfully delicious! Every bun was a happy surprise.

Finally, with full, happy tummies, they snuggled close together. They agreed the very best part of the picnic was being together in the sunny meadow, sharing every bun, no matter what they guessed.

Ever since then, picnics were extra special, filled with happy guesses, wonderful sharing, and delightful giggles, making every bite a happy surprise.
characters: Poppy the goose, Daisy the pony, Aunt Olive
